notes: Rebuild from the Atria trending deep dive (rising image ads in footwear/foot pain, Oct 2026). Each concept recreates one rising format (attached as layout reference) with our nurse/travel copy. Nurse colors restricted; light backgrounds; 7% margins.

concepts.headline: Dear Nurses, Work your 12s without sore feet.
concepts.prompt: Clean white background. Top-left two-line headline in dark charcoal, the key words bold: "Dear " + bold "Nurses," / "Work your " + bold "12s" + " without sore feet." Left column: four rows, each a grey struck-through problem then a bold royal-blue benefit: ~~"Too tight"~~ "Wide toe box" / ~~"Flat by hour 6"~~ "Cushioned rocker sole" / ~~"Slippery floors"~~ "Slip-resistant grip" / ~~"Retying laces"~~ "No-tie bungee laces". Right: one black-and-purple shoe from the product reference in side view, large and sharp, and above it the same shoe seen from the top with a green dashed double arrow across the wide toe box. Bottom center: a black rounded pill with white bold "$59.95". All text is huge, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+, with at least 7% clear margin between every text element and every edge. Light or mid-tone background so the shoe stands out. Never copy any word from the second attached image. No other text anywhere.
concepts.angle: Dear Nurses, Work your 12s without sore feet.

concepts.headline: How I stopped limping to my car after 12s
concepts.prompt: A casual real smartphone photo of a tablet propped on a kitchen counter, a finger pointing at its screen. The screen shows a side-by-side photo of a woman's foot from the side: left, in a worn flat sneaker with a red hand-drawn line showing the arch collapsing and red pressure arrows at the heel; right, in the all-black shoe from the product reference with a green line showing a supported arch and green curved arrows. Below the tablet, a light-blue sticky note with black handwriting: "How I stopped limping to my car after 12s". The only words are on the sticky note.
